react.question: How do I convert an SVG into a React component?
react.answer: Paste your SVG code or upload a file. CrushSVG converts supported SVG attributes and inline styles to JSX syntax, wraps the markup in a component, and generates code you can copy into your project.

react.question: Does this converter support TypeScript (TSX)?
react.answer: Yes. Choose the TypeScript output to generate a typed React component with props extending React.SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>. The generated code may need imports or adjustments to match your project setup.

react.question: Can I use the converted components in React Native and Next.js?
react.answer: The generator has output options for React Native SVG and React components that can be used in Next.js. Check the generated code and install the framework-specific dependencies required by your project.

react.question: Why should I convert inline SVGs into React components instead of using tags?
react.answer: A React component places the SVG markup in your component tree, which can make supported fills, strokes, and other props easier to style with CSS or Tailwind. It can also avoid a separate image request for that SVG, depending on how your app uses the component.

svgPage.question: How do I convert SVG to PNG?
svgPage.answer: Paste your SVG code into the editor or upload or drag in an .svg file. Choose a width, height or scale, switch on Transparent background if you need one, then click Convert and download your PNG.

svgPage.question: Is this SVG to PNG converter free, and are there limits?
svgPage.answer: Yes. You can convert up to 3 SVGs to PNG without logging in. Log in for unlimited free SVG-to-PNG conversions.

svgPage.question: Can I set custom dimensions and a transparent background?
svgPage.answer: Yes. Enable the Transparent Background option before converting your SVG to download a PNG with a transparent background. You can also set an exact width and height in pixels (1 to 4000) or use a scale from 0.1x to 16x.

svgPage.question: What is the maximum PNG size?
svgPage.answer: The output is capped at 4000 pixels per side. If your width, height or scale would go over that, the tool shows an error so you can lower it.

svgPage.question: Are my files kept private?
svgPage.answer: Yes. Browser-based conversions are processed locally in your browser, while API-based conversions are processed on our server. For more details, see our Privacy Policy.

svgPage.question: Can I convert complex SVGs with gradients, clipping paths or embedded styles?
svgPage.answer: Yes, CrushSVG supports linear and radial gradients, clipping paths, embedded styles and nested SVG groups.

svg.question: How do I turn an SVG into a high-resolution PNG without losing quality?
svg.answer: SVG artwork can be rendered at different output sizes because it is defined with vector instructions rather than a fixed pixel grid. CrushSVG lets you choose a scale or custom dimensions and renders the PNG up to the 4,000-pixel-per-side output limit. For the sharpest result, choose dimensions suited to how you will use the image.

svg.question: Does CrushSVG support transparent background exports?
svg.answer: Yes. Transparent is the default background option, and PNG supports alpha transparency. The exported image preserves transparent areas from the SVG, making it useful for websites, app interfaces, and designs that need a transparent background.

svg.question: Can I turn complex SVG files from Figma, Illustrator, and Canva into PNG?
svg.answer: CrushSVG converts valid SVG files exported from design tools such as Figma, Adobe Illustrator, and Canva. Common SVG features such as gradients, clipping paths, and grouped artwork are supported; rendering can vary with external resources, fonts, and less common SVG features, so check the preview before downloading.

svg.question: Are my uploaded graphics and designs stored on your servers?
svg.answer: Processing depends on the conversion path: some SVGs are rendered in your browser, while others are sent to the CrushSVG conversion API for processing. Conversion files are not intended to be stored as user assets. Read our Privacy Policy for details about processing and data handling.

svg.question: What is the difference between converting SVG to PNG vs JPG?
svg.answer: PNG uses lossless compression and supports transparency, which makes it a good choice for logos, icons, and graphics with transparent areas. JPG uses lossy compression and does not support transparency, so transparent areas need a solid background.

bg.question: How do I remove a white background from a logo for free?
bg.answer: Upload a PNG, JPG, or WebP logo and run the background-removal tool. Preview the result and download the transparent PNG if it meets your needs. Guest conversions have a free usage limit.

bg.question: Does this background remover work for Cricut and Print-on-Demand designs?
bg.answer: The tool exports a PNG with transparency that you can import into Cricut Design Space, Silhouette Studio, or a print-on-demand workflow. Check the cutout edges and dimensions in your target application before production.

bg.question: Are there file limits or subscription fees?
bg.answer: Uploads are limited to 2 MB, and guest conversions are limited. CrushSVG offers free use; account access follows the current conversion quota rules.

bg.question: What image formats can I upload?
bg.answer: The background remover accepts PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WebP images up to 2 MB per upload.

resizer.question: Can I resize an image without losing quality?
resizer.answer: Resizing uses the browser Canvas API. Scaling down can preserve useful detail, while enlarging an image cannot create source detail and may look soft. Preview the result and choose dimensions appropriate for the intended use.

resizer.question: How do I resize an image for Cricut Design Space?
resizer.answer: Upload your design, enter the desired pixel width and height, keep the aspect ratio locked if you do not want distortion, and download the result. Check the displayed size again after importing it into Cricut Design Space.

resizer.question: Does resizing a transparent PNG turn the background white?
resizer.answer: PNG output preserves alpha transparency from the source image. JPG output requires an opaque background because JPEG does not support transparency.

resizer.question: Is this image resizer completely free?
resizer.answer: The image resizer is free to use and adds no download watermark. Uploads are limited to 10 MB, and output dimensions are capped at 10,000 pixels per side.

raster.question: Does CrushSVG create real vector paths or just embed the PNG inside an SVG?
raster.answer: For logos, illustrations, and line art, CrushSVG traces the image into editable SVG paths. Photographs are handled differently: the PNG is embedded in an SVG to preserve photo detail, so those pixels are not editable vector paths. The result includes an advisory describing the mode used.

raster.question: Can I use the converted SVG file for Cricut, Silhouette, and laser cutters?
raster.answer: SVG path output can be imported into design and cutting tools such as Cricut Design Space, Silhouette Studio, and many laser workflows. Check the traced paths in your target software before cutting, since results depend on the source image and tracing settings; photographs may be embedded as raster images instead of cut paths.

raster.question: How can I achieve the cleanest vector tracing results?
raster.answer: Use high-contrast images with clear edges, such as silhouettes, typography, logos, line art, and flat illustrations. Minimal compression noise and fewer photographic gradients generally make tracing cleaner.

raster.question: Is it completely free to convert PNG to SVG on CrushSVG?
raster.answer: You can start with three free conversions without signing in. Verified accounts have unlimited conversions under the current quota rules.

raster.question: What raster file formats are supported for vectorization?
raster.answer: The PNG to SVG tool accepts PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WebP images. High-contrast artwork, logos, and illustrations generally produce the most useful vector paths.

optimizer.question: How does SVG optimization reduce file size?
optimizer.answer: The optimizer can remove selected comments, editor metadata, redundant markup, and empty groups, and round coordinate decimals. The amount saved depends on the source SVG and the options selected; compare the output size and preview before using it.

optimizer.question: Does optimizing an SVG reduce visual quality?
optimizer.answer: Removing comments and metadata does not change the rendered artwork, but rounding path coordinates can change it slightly. Choose an appropriate precision and compare the preview with the original.

optimizer.question: How does SVG compression improve Google Core Web Vitals?
optimizer.answer: A smaller SVG may take less time to transfer, which can help page loading when that asset affects the experience. Optimization alone does not guarantee better Core Web Vitals scores, and it does not directly prevent layout shifts.

optimizer.question: Is this tool free and secure?
optimizer.answer: The SVG optimizer runs in your browser and does not upload your SVG for optimization. It is free to use; review the preview and output before publishing the optimized file.

favicon.question: What formats does this favicon generator produce?
favicon.answer: The ZIP includes a multi-resolution favicon.ico with 16?16, 32?32, 48?48, 64?64, 128?128, and 256?256 entries; a 180?180 Apple Touch PNG; 192?192 and 512?512 Android manifest PNG icons; site.webmanifest; and HTML link tags. A 512?512 WebP can be downloaded separately. The generator currently takes SVG input and does not create an SVG favicon.

favicon.question: Can I convert an SVG into a favicon with a transparent background?
favicon.answer: Yes. Choose a transparent background to preserve transparent areas when rendering the SVG icons. Preview the results against light and dark backgrounds.

favicon.question: How do I install the generated favicon in Next.js?
favicon.answer: Place favicon.ico in the root app directory to use the Next.js App Router favicon convention, or place the generated files in public and add the provided link tags using paths that match their deployed locations.

favicon.question: Is this favicon pack generator free?
favicon.answer: Yes. You can generate and download the favicon assets for free without creating an account.
